title: Get Bestselling LIVE Sessions
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-10-13
html:
Path: /analytics/202511/lives/bestselling

Method: [GET]

Function Description

Get up to 100 LIVE sessions ranked by GMV for the period defined by date and time_slot.

Common Parameters

For common parameters, refer to How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters

Properties Location Type Require Sample Properties description
shop_cipher query string Y GCP_XF90igAAAABh00qsWgtvOiGFNqyubMt3 Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response.
Get by API Get Authorization Shop
content-type header string Y application/json Allowed type: application/json

Request Query Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
app_key string Y 38abcd Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.
sign string Y 5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.
timestamp int Y 1623812664 Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.
date string N 2025-11-13 The reference date, in ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format and the shop's registered timezone. The period ends on this date, inclusive, and extends backward according to time_slot (for example, 7D covers the seven days ending on this date). The date must be on or before the latest available data date. If a later date is submitted, the error response states the latest available data date; retry the request with that date or an earlier one.
time_slot string N 7D Specifies the query time range. Supported values are:
  • 1D: query data for 1 day
  • 7D: query data for 7 days
  • 30D: query data for 30 days

This field determines the maximum range that can be queried using the date field. | currency |string |N |USD |Currency for monetary values. Use USD for US dollars or LOCAL for the local currency where the shop is registered. If omitted, this parameter defaults to LOCAL. |

Request Sample

Query

https://open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com/analytics/202511/lives/bestselling?app_key=123abc&sign=5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c&timestamp=1625484268&shop_cipher=ROW_RHkDDABBAAB8tKAVoAqsMTjsQZFLyNfY&date=2025-11-13&time_slot=7D&currency=USD

Response Parameters

Properties Type Sample Properties description
code int 0 The success or failure status code returned in API response.
message string Success The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
request_id string 202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7 Request log
data object Specific return information
^lives []object List of bestselling LIVE session records for the target date range.
^^rank int 1 GMV rank of the LIVE session
^^gmv_range string $97000.00~$191000.00 GMV range of the LIVE session.
^^id string 399123 LIVE session id
^^title string Dude's deal LIVE session title
^^start_time int 1623812664 Start time of the LIVE session as a Unix timestamp in seconds (UTC+00:00).
^^duration int 7602 LIVE session duration, in seconds.
^^creator_name string abc_bec The creator’s unique username used for system identification.
^^open_id string 41YL0AAAAAD7kUt1BK3H07WBF3MZWzCgL79vJ-xBgswGeL2BCGdmeQ The creator’s unique ID, uniquely identifying the creator in the system.
^^creator_nick_name string ttnickname The creator’s display nickname, visible externally.
